english.title: Possessing explosive, noxious substance or electrical device with intent to take fish
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) possessed

(A)_[an explosive substance,]_
(B)_[a noxious substance,]_
(C)_[an electrical device,]_

namely, **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE OR DEVICE..), for the purpose of using it in or near waters at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) with intent thereby to take or destroy fish
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(4) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

english.notes:
(i) Section 5(2) of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 provides that section 5(1) shall not apply to the use by a person of any substance or device (a) for a scientific purpose, or for the purpose of protecting, improving or replacing stocks of fish; and (b) with the permission in writing of the Agency, for which the Agency may charge a fee.
(ii) Section 5(2A) of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 provides that section 5(1) shall not apply to anything done pursuant to an authorisation granted by the Agency under section 27A of that Act.
(iii) Paragraph 2 of Part II of Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975 provides that any offence against this Act committed on the sea-coast or at sea beyond the ordinary jurisdiction of a court of summary jurisdiction shall be deemed to have been committed in any place abutting on that sea-coast or adjoining that sea, and may be tried and punished accordingly.
